answer: Oyster farmer lease with harbour commissioners attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because each lease is a farmed bed worked and inspected by harbour commissioners, so a hundred fakes need a hundred real oyster beds, the anchor of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the tundra is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke. The vault is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
